description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Open the setup assistant: a chat that interviews the owner and saves the answers (hours, services, policies, transfers...) into the knowledge profile and routing. Returns the open conversation with the assistant's opening message (restart=true starts over). Capped per business per day. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_start_setup_chat
title: Start setup chat
